style.toneOfVoice: <p>Bring the winter season inside with this pre lit Christmas Collection Garland. At 1.5m long and with 50 warm white micro LEDs wound through the mixed faux foliage alongside sprays of white berries, this showstopping piece is sure to become a staple of your Christmas display. Drape this beautiful garland along the mantelpiece, arrange it above a dresser for a luxurious touch to your festive decor or weave it around TruGlow® pillar candles on the table to add a cosy sparkle to festive dinner parties.&nbsp;</p><p>For illumination, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the attached battery box. Set the handy 6 hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening.</p><p>Size : ONE.</p>
